_about: Terms used in the Education Channel Audit Tool (ECA), Red Bull Australia student marketing. Keys are the terms as written in the app and docs.

terms.definition: Education Channel Audit Tool: this app.
Red Bull's university and TAFE campus channel: stores, bars and vending machines on or near campuses.
Student employed by Red Bull to run campus activity and audit stores. Role 'marketeer' in code.
Red Bull staff member managing Student Marketeers in one state; approves audits.
National user with full access; changes settings, finalises and distributes monthly results.
Administrator responsible for a state; decides removal requests and receives daily summaries.
A university or TAFE record, one per state.
Technical and Further Education institute (vocational college). Yellow tag in the app.
A store (QSR, Student Bar, Convenience, NKA) or vending machine that gets audited. ID like MON-012 or MON-VM-012.
Quick Service Restaurant: cafés and food outlets. Also the default store location type and the non-vending location kind in code.
National Key Account: chain outlets (e.g. Subway, Guzman y Gomez) managed nationally rather than by the campus team.
Independent outlet (not a national key account).
Campus bar, pub or tavern store location type.
Convenience store location type (none classified yet).
Vending machine location type; has machine fields (company, machine ID, V/Monster SKUs and prices).
One of QSR, Vending, Student Bar, Convenience, NKA. Admin-managed list.
A Completed visit with the six-step form.
Completed, Scheduled or Cancelled. Only Completed resets the visit cycle.
Days between required visits; default 14.

terms.term: On Track / Due Soon / Overdue / No Visit Recorded
terms.definition: Location statuses from the last Completed visit and cycle. Due Soon = due within 3 days.
Whether a product is stocked (Yes/No) at a location.
Red Bull SKUs ranged ÷ Red Bull SKUs checked (or applicable, on the leaderboard) at a location, averaged.
Stock keeping unit: one product variant (e.g. Red Bull Energy Drink, Sugarfree, Zero, Editions).
Red Bull Energy Drink, Sugarfree, Zero.
Red Bull flavoured Editions range; 'Editions sold in' = units/listings of Editions gained on a visit.
Distribution point: one SKU ranged at one location. Adding ED and Zero to a new fridge = 2 DPs added.
Total distribution points; on the leaderboard 'TDP added' = sum of DPs added on approved audits.
DPs added minus DPs lost.
Number of cans/product faces visible at the front of the shelf or fridge (or vending columns).
Red Bull front facings ÷ (Red Bull + all competitor front facings).
Point of sale material: price tags, wobblers, posters, shelf strips, fridge decals, counter units, menu boards, vending decals.
Red Bull branded fridge. 'Coolers placed' = installed on a visit.
Red Bull display/merchandising standards recorded per store.
On-premise (consumed on site) or off-premise (take-away retail).
Store priority grade.
Monster, Monster Ultra, V (and V Sugarfree, V Blue), Solo Energy, Rockstar, Celsius, plus brands added in the field.
Pending, Approved, Rejected or Duplicate. Only Approved audits score.
Monthly ranking of Student Marketeers by weighted score (Ranging 30, TDP 25, Editions 20, POS 15, Coolers 10).
A month's leaderboard: In review after rollover, Final after an Admin finalises.
Admin locks a month's results, then sends them to chosen groups.
Second check before sensitive admin actions (prototype PIN; production Entra MFA).
Share of active locations audited at least once in the period.
Per Student Marketeer per day with 2+ audits; sent to state Leads and Managers at 18:00.
Monthly state report for Managers and Leads / national report for Admins, on the 1st.
Excel of every audit in a month, one sheet per state, with a Dashboard of charts; generated on the last calendar day.
Student Marketeer's request to remove a closed or wrong location or institution; decided by the Education Channel Lead.
The claude.ai artifact database that gives all signed-in users the same live data. 'This browser only' = not connected.
Generated leaderboard audits for the 8 VIC workbook staff in the prototype; removable in Settings.
Microsoft's business database behind Power Apps; the production system of record.
Dataverse security boundary; one per state in the ECA design.
Small library that lets the prototype write React markup with tagged template strings instead of JSX.
The five Education Channel (Catering) KPIs: Availability, Perfect Placement, Perfect Visibility, Consumption Activation and Win vs Comp.
Energy Drink, a low-cal (Sugarfree or Zero) and an Edition. Availability is met when all three are ranged.
Red Bull is in the main fridge, or where the purchase decision is made (grab & go fridge, beverage fridge near the till).
The Red Bull fridge placement in the store is easy for customers to see.
Activation in store (price tags, menu board, wobbler). It only counts when pricing is shown.
Red Bull has more front facings than the top competitor in the whole store.
Extras that are not part of Hi5 but worth recording, e.g. can glorifier, window decals, ambient display.
